name: Арбалетчик Гвоздя
notes: One of Гвоздь's crossbowmen, a generic type fought in pairs. A clanless dwarf with a heavy arbalest who never stands in the open: he shoots from behind stacked crates or barrels, reloads on the move, and puts a bolt into anyone who lands a blow on his employer. Behind real cover he uses the basic Take Cover action for greater cover. He counts as one of Гвоздь's bought men for Bought Men.

actions.name: Running Reload
actions.text: The crossbowman Strides, Steps, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Sneak]{Sneaks}, then Interacts to reload.

actions.name: Hobbling Bolt
actions.text:
Frequency once per round

Effect The crossbowman makes an arbalest Strike against a creature within the weapon's first range increment, aiming low at the legs. If it hits, the creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.Effect: Hamstring]

actions.name: Covering Shot
actions.text:
Trigger An enemy the crossbowman can see within 110 feet hits Гвоздь or one of the crossbowman's allies with a melee Strike

Effect The crossbowman makes an arbalest Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward his multiple attack penalty, and his multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to it.

actions.name: Sniper's Edge
actions.text: The crossbowman's ranged Strikes deal 2d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] creatures.

actions.name: Surprise Attack
actions.text: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] to the crossbowman.
